# WHAT WAS DONE (base file edits
# 1. Data/2017/FI/Demands.csv — IND electricity reclassified (Stats Finland boundary):
#    Total IND energy preserved: 83245.600 GWh  ✓

#    motor+process electricity as HEAT_HIGH_T.  Stats Finland records it as
#    ELECTRICITY (commodity-flow accounting).  Δ=21.1 TWh aligns with Stats
#    Finland 2017 IND FEC electricity ≈ 44.5 TWh vs JRC-IDEES 23.4 TWh.
#    For the full forensic audit see: Docs/finland2017_demand_boundary_audit.md

# PENDING RECALIBRATION AFTER v27 RUN:

#    With new HEAT_HIGH_T=38720 GWh:  minimum heat = 0.44 × 38720 = 17037 GWh
#    → by-product electricity ≈ 5.8 TWh  (vs 8.96 TWh in v26)
#    ELEC_CHP will drop ~3 TWh below current 21.27 → needs upward fmin_perc adjustment
#    if ELEC_CHP falls below reference 20.735 TWh by >5%.
#    Suggested v28 patch range: fmin_perc 0.44 → 0.55–0.65 (to recover ~7–8 TWh IND CHP electricity)
# 4. ELEC_IMPORTS scoring — currently weight=0.0 in reality/finland_2017_reference.csv
#    After v27 run: if model ELEC_IMPORTS lands in 10–18 TWh range
#    Reference value to use: 16.9 TWh (Stats Finland 2017 net imports)
# 5. PE_BIOMASS — expect large drop (~20 TWh) due to less IND_COGEN_WOOD + BOILER_WOOD
#    PE_BIOMASS reference = 100 TWh; if model undershoots
